meta.title: Why is my BESCOM transfer blocked?
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic demonstration data only — not official BESCOM or government guidance. Every claim and source in this fixture is invented to test the renderer. Replace this file with audited research before public use.

scenarios.label: Clean sale
scenarios.summary: A registered sale is present and no property-record mismatch is known.

scenarios.label: Draft or pending e-Khata
scenarios.summary: The municipal record exists, but its final state is unresolved.

scenarios.label: EPID mapping failure
scenarios.summary: A property identifier is visible, but the utility account cannot resolve it.

scenarios.label: Tenant
scenarios.summary: An occupier needs a bill-name change without owning the property.

scenarios.label: Previous consumer deceased
scenarios.summary: A successor is seeking transfer after the recorded consumer died.

scenarios.label: Consent unavailable
scenarios.summary: The previous consumer cannot or will not provide the expected consent.

claims.text: [Synthetic placeholder] A registered conveyance is treated as the upstream ownership record in the clean-sale path.
claims.notes: Invented claim for renderer coverage; it is not a legal conclusion.

claims.text: [Synthetic placeholder] The service portal asks for a final municipal record before exposing the property identifier.
claims.notes: Invented interface behavior; marked partial to test visible caveats.

claims.text: [Synthetic placeholder] An archived instruction suggests the purchaser name must match the mutation record.
claims.notes: Invented archived guidance; deliberately not treated as current.

claims.text: [Synthetic placeholder] A professional explainer attributes some transfer blocks to a failed identifier-to-account handoff.
claims.notes: Invented inference retained only to exercise grade D.

claims.text: [Synthetic placeholder] One tenant reports being asked for prior-consumer consent.
claims.notes: A single invented account must not be generalized.

claims.text: [Synthetic placeholder] An uncorroborated note says an offline exception may exist when consent is unavailable.
claims.notes: Invented assertion; included to demonstrate a weak-source warning.

claims.text: [Synthetic placeholder] The exact succession documents needed for this branch have not been verified.
claims.notes: The missing evidence is intentional and must remain visible.

claims.text: [Synthetic placeholder] The observed interface appears to create the utility mapping automatically after identifier validation.
claims.notes: Invented interface inference paired with a deliberate contradiction.

claims.text: [Synthetic placeholder] A citizen account says staff had to create the utility mapping manually.
claims.notes: Invented citizen account paired with a deliberate contradiction.

nodes.label: Sale deed
nodes.summary: The registered document that starts the synthetic clean-sale journey.
nodes.requiredState: Synthetic target: registered, legible, and naming the same purchaser used downstream.

checks.label: Check registration state
checks.description: Synthetic check: compare the displayed registration state and purchaser name.

failureSignals.label: Purchaser name mismatch
failureSignals.description: Synthetic failure: the name shown downstream differs from the deed.
failureSignals.actualError: Synthetic example: Applicant name does not match source record

recoveries.label: Verify the source record
recoveries.description: Synthetic recovery: confirm the registered record before changing a downstream system.

nodes.label: Succession record
nodes.summary: The unverified set of documents that may establish who can act after a death.
nodes.requiredState: Unknown: the fixture deliberately does not assert which succession documents are sufficient.

checks.label: Ask for the current document list
checks.description: Synthetic check: obtain a current written list from the responsible office.

failureSignals.label: Unspecified document rejection
failureSignals.description: Synthetic failure: a generic rejection does not name the missing succession record.

recoveries.label: Request a written checklist
recoveries.description: Synthetic recovery: ask the responsible office to identify the missing item in writing.

nodes.label: Occupancy & consent
nodes.summary: The basis on which a non-owner or exception applicant is allowed to proceed.
nodes.requiredState: Contested: the synthetic sources disagree on when consent or an exception is accepted.

checks.label: Check the applicable route
checks.description: Synthetic check: distinguish tenant, owner, and consent-unavailable routes.

failureSignals.label: Consent prompt blocks progress
failureSignals.description: Synthetic failure: the interface requests consent but exposes no exception path.
failureSignals.actualError: Synthetic example: Previous consumer consent required

recoveries.label: Ask for the exception checklist
recoveries.description: Synthetic recovery: request written confirmation of any alternate route.

nodes.label: Mutation
nodes.summary: A downstream property-record change represented by intentionally incomplete evidence.
nodes.requiredState: Synthetic target: purchaser identity matches the registered source document.

checks.label: Compare the recorded name
checks.description: Synthetic check: compare the mutation holder with the deed purchaser.

failureSignals.label: Mutation remains pending
failureSignals.description: Synthetic failure: the next municipal record cannot reach final state.

recoveries.label: Resolve the upstream mismatch
recoveries.description: Synthetic recovery: correct or complete the mutation record before retrying downstream.

nodes.label: Final e-Khata
nodes.summary: The municipal record state whose Draft versus Final distinction matters in this fixture.
nodes.requiredState: Synthetic target: status explicitly displays Final rather than Draft or Pending.

checks.label: Read the record state
checks.description: Synthetic check: look for an explicit Draft, Pending, or Final label.

failureSignals.label: Record remains Draft
failureSignals.description: Synthetic failure: identifier generation or mapping is unavailable while the record is Draft.
failureSignals.actualError: Synthetic example: Final property record not available

recoveries.label: Complete the upstream record
recoveries.description: Synthetic recovery: resolve the mutation dependency and ask how the record reaches Final.

nodes.label: EPID
nodes.summary: A synthetic property identifier that must survive the handoff to the utility account.
nodes.requiredState: Synthetic target: an identifier is visible and matches the property record used in the mapping check.

checks.label: Confirm the identifier
checks.description: Synthetic check: verify that the final record exposes an identifier.

failureSignals.label: Identifier cannot be resolved
failureSignals.description: Synthetic failure: the utility lookup rejects an identifier that appears upstream.
failureSignals.actualError: Synthetic example: Property identifier not found

recoveries.label: Compare both system records
recoveries.description: Synthetic recovery: capture the non-sensitive identifiers shown by both public views and ask which record owns correction.

nodes.label: BESCOM mapping
nodes.summary: The system handoff between a property identifier and the electricity account.
nodes.requiredState: Contested: the fixture deliberately disagrees on whether mapping is automatic or staff-mediated.

checks.label: Check the mapping result
checks.description: Synthetic check: record whether the account lookup recognizes the property identifier.

failureSignals.label: Mapping unavailable
failureSignals.description: Synthetic failure: the utility account cannot resolve the upstream identifier.

recoveries.label: Identify the correction owner
recoveries.description: Synthetic recovery: ask which agency must correct the handoff before retrying transfer.

nodes.label: Name transfer
nodes.summary: The electricity account displays the new consumer name after every prerequisite passes.
nodes.requiredState: Synthetic target: the submitted route, property mapping, and applicant basis are accepted.

checks.label: Read the final application state
checks.description: Synthetic check: distinguish accepted, pending, and rejected states.

failureSignals.label: Generic rejection
failureSignals.description: Synthetic failure: the final response does not identify which upstream node failed.
failureSignals.actualError: Synthetic example: Transfer cannot be processed

recoveries.label: Return to the earliest failed node
recoveries.description: Synthetic recovery: use the highlighted path to resolve the first non-ready dependency.

roadblocks.title: Draft and Final are not explained together
roadblocks.symptom: A synthetic applicant sees Draft but cannot tell what is missing.
roadblocks.likelyCause: The fixture intentionally separates a status label from its prerequisite explanation.
roadblocks.recovery: Use the node checks to identify the mutation dependency and request a written completion step.

roadblocks.title: Consent exception has no published route
roadblocks.symptom: The synthetic flow asks for consent but does not explain the unavailable-consent branch.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Only an uncorroborated placeholder claim describes an exception.
roadblocks.recovery: Ask the responsible office for the current exception checklist instead of relying on the fixture.

roadblocks.title: Tenant route depends on contested consent evidence
roadblocks.symptom: A synthetic tenant cannot tell whether occupancy evidence can substitute for consent.
roadblocks.likelyCause: The only placeholder evidence is a single citizen account.
roadblocks.recovery: Confirm the current applicant categories and required documents with the utility.

roadblocks.title: Succession checklist is unknown
roadblocks.symptom: A synthetic successor receives a generic supporting-document rejection.
roadblocks.likelyCause: The fixture has no usable source for the deceased-consumer branch.
roadblocks.recovery: Request an itemized, current checklist and keep this branch marked unknown until sourced.

roadblocks.title: Automatic and manual mapping claims conflict
roadblocks.symptom: The synthetic identifier exists upstream but the utility account cannot resolve it.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Two placeholder sources disagree on whether the handoff is automatic or staff-mediated.
roadblocks.recovery: Compare the two public record states and ask the agencies to identify the correction owner.

roadblocks.title: Final error hides the upstream blocker
roadblocks.symptom: The synthetic transfer ends with a generic rejection instead of naming the failed dependency.
roadblocks.likelyCause: The final service response does not preserve an upstream failure reason.
roadblocks.recovery: Trace backward to the earliest non-ready node and verify that record first.

journeys.title: Synthetic clean-sale path
journeys.context: Demonstrates the full six-node happy path without asserting that it is real guidance.

steps.label: Confirm source record
steps.action: Compare the synthetic deed name with the next record.

steps.label: Confirm final property record
steps.action: Read the synthetic Draft or Final label.

steps.label: Test the handoff
steps.action: Check whether the synthetic account resolves the identifier.
steps.expectedResult: The account and property record map.

dependencies.description: Synthetic ownership records must remain consistent across the chain.

recoveryNotes: Resolve the earliest mismatch before retrying the final transfer.
documentationQualityNotes: Synthetic sources make the sequence look cleaner than real research may support.
Automatic versus manual mapping remains deliberately contested.

journeys.title: Synthetic Draft e-Khata path
journeys.context: Exercises a partial municipal record and the downstream effects of that state.

steps.label: Read record state
steps.action: Identify whether the synthetic record says Draft, Pending, or Final.

steps.label: Retry after finalization
steps.action: Retry only after the upstream record changes.
steps.expectedResult: The final flow exposes a new outcome.

dependencies.description: The synthetic Final state depends on the mutation check.

recoveryNotes: Ask which unresolved upstream step keeps the record in Draft.
documentationQualityNotes: The fixture intentionally provides no authoritative transition rule from Draft to Final.

journeys.title: Synthetic EPID mapping failure path
journeys.context: Exercises a cross-system contradiction with a visible upstream identifier.

steps.label: Test utility mapping
steps.action: Check whether the synthetic account resolves it.
steps.expectedResult: The handoff either resolves or returns a specific failure.

steps.label: Find the correction owner
steps.action: Ask which side owns the mismatch.
steps.expectedResult: One agency accepts responsibility for correction.

dependencies.description: Two synthetic systems must agree on the property identity.

recoveryNotes: Preserve non-sensitive evidence of both displayed states while asking for correction ownership.
documentationQualityNotes: The fixture deliberately leaves staff-mediated versus automatic mapping unresolved.

journeys.title: Synthetic tenant path
journeys.context: Exercises a non-owner applicant route with weak citizen evidence.

steps.label: Identify applicant basis
steps.expectedResult: The flow names the relevant applicant category.

steps.label: Check consent requirement
steps.expectedResult: The requirement and alternatives are explicit.

steps.label: Submit the correct route
steps.action: Use only the verified applicant path.
steps.expectedResult: The result names any remaining blocker.

dependencies.description: The synthetic transfer depends on the accepted applicant basis.

recoveryNotes: Do not generalize the fixture’s single citizen account; confirm current categories.
documentationQualityNotes: The tenant branch has no synthetic primary source and remains contested.

journeys.title: Synthetic deceased-consumer path
journeys.context: Exercises a branch where the critical document list is explicitly unknown.

steps.label: Request document list
steps.action: Ask for a current written synthetic checklist.
steps.expectedResult: The missing evidence is named item by item.

steps.label: Check downstream names
steps.action: Compare the successor path with the property record.

steps.label: Confirm exception route
steps.action: Ask whether an alternate route exists.
steps.expectedResult: A sourced rule replaces the placeholder assertion.

dependencies.description: An unknown synthetic succession step precedes the property-record handoff.

recoveryNotes: Keep the branch unknown until a current source names the required documents.
documentationQualityNotes: No usable source exists in the fixture for the succession checklist.

journeys.title: Synthetic consent-unavailable path
journeys.context: Exercises a contested exception path and a grade F assertion.

steps.label: Confirm the blocking prompt
steps.action: Record the synthetic consent requirement without personal data.
steps.expectedResult: The failure is specific enough to route.

steps.label: Verify an exception
steps.action: Ask for a current written exception route.
steps.expectedResult: A stronger source replaces the grade F placeholder.

steps.label: Retry with verified route
steps.action: Retry only after the accepted route is confirmed.
steps.expectedResult: The service names any next blocker.

dependencies.description: The synthetic alternative is not established by reliable evidence.

recoveryNotes: Treat the offline-exception statement as a lead to verify, not an instruction.
documentationQualityNotes: The only exception claim is deliberately grade F and contested.
